degree_rationale: Three births of flesh — those begotten from one another, those from abortions, those that mold themselves alone; with detail on which trees sprout from cuttings vs. which don't, depending on where their enthumesis is placed. direction_rationale: North-turn at the natural: inward reception of how begetting works — distinguishing types and the inner cause (where enthumesis is placed). Reflective bodily classification.
grand_man_function: Natural begetting-reception — the inward sorting of generations.
title: The three births of the flesh and where each comes from
